visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black T-shirt and a black baseball cap sits at a wooden table in front of a blue and red lit background. He reaches for a silver and black briefcase. (2) Close-up shot as the man's hands unlatch the briefcase, revealing a blue cardboard box inside with colorful illustrations and text reading 'WARMONGER'. (3) The man lifts the box out, displaying the front which features a large horned monster graphic, then turns it to show the back covered in comic strip panels. (4) The man unfolds a paper instruction manual that displays black and white line drawings of the monster head toy and its internal mechanisms. (5) A close-up shows the toy itself: a red, brain-textured head with large white horns, sitting on a purple and blue base on the wooden table. (6) The man's fingers place a tiny plastic figure of a boy with a red cap near the large monster head. (7) The monster head is hinged and opens downward to reveal a complex interior playset with a blue beetle, a small dungeon cell, and a silver rotating blade. (8) The man points to the bottom of the toy where 'PeariA' is embossed in the plastic. (9) A static graphic appears showing two green and grey monster head toys under the text 'Godzilla vs Biollante'. (10) The man sits back at the table with several toys arranged in front of him, gesturing with his hands while looking at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp metallic click of a briefcase latch opening is followed by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a steady kick-drum beat. A male voice enters with high energy and a friendly, welcoming tone saying 'Here it comes'. (2) As the BGM continues, the voice assumes a narrative tone, explaining the rarity of the vintage toy with high articulation clarity and moderate pitch variability. (3) A crisp paper rustling sound is layered over the music as the manual is unfolded, accompanied by a rapid series of vocal phrases without many pauses. (4) A solid thud is heard as the toy is placed on the table, followed by a 'ding' sound effect used for emphasis during the price discussion. (5) Multiple mechanical sliding and clicking SFX occur in rapid succession, synced with the display of toy mechanisms, while the BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic flow. (6) A series of 'whoosh' and 'clink' post-production sound effects are introduced as internal playset features are revealed, while the vocal arousal remains high. (7) A cartoonish 'poof' or explosion SFX marks a transition, followed by a stabilizing narrative voice describing the brand. (8) The music persists at a constant volume through the end of the clip as the speaker delivers a enthusiastic concluding statement.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Unboxing -> Feature Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase a rare and high-value vintage-style toy ('WARMONGER' from the 'Mighty Max' style) to a hobbyist audience. It emphasizes the toy's rarity, high market price, and intricate mechanical features to evoke nostalgia and brand interest for 'PeariA'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the brand 'PeariA', shows their social media information, and encourages viewers to check the information bar for pre-orders.
